dissents.reason: It fails my first test because its 26-week channel slopes down (6% a year) and its MACD line is still below zero, so this is a bounce 2.2 widths above a falling line, not a pullback in a rising channel.

A cyclical refiner at 22.1x trailing earnings that just jumped 159.9% on what the draft calls a war premium, after a 31.91% twelve-week run and with the book's highest weekly volatility at 5.04%, is paying a full multiple for event-driven earnings and leaves no margin of safety if that premium fades during the week.
